name: Magnum Opus R-9 radial engine
description: A nine-cylinder radial engine: master and link rods, cams, a planetary reduction gear and a propeller, with a drawing of every part.

name: Robot arm R6
description: A six-axis arm with a gripper, driven by stepper motors: it picks up a workpiece and puts it down, and every part has its drawing.

name: Stewart platform S6
description: A platform on six legs with ball joints, moved by the legs' lengths alone: six closed loops solved together.
